fact: The WHO Algeria office's 2022-2023 biennial report says the Ministry of Health, under its digital health strategy and with WHO support, began training health practitioners and IT staff to use the DHIS2 platform for the national health information system, with a first five-day session for 20 people in December 2023, and that the draft national digital health strategy was pre-validated at a workshop in November 2023 before submission to the national authorities.
title: Rapport biennal 2022-2023
publisher: Organisation mondiale de la Santé, Bureau de l'Algérie
